intro.text: Emperor Ashravan's red-haired wife, killed by Glory Faction assassins in the attack that destroyed her husband's mind.
The late Empress of the Rose Empire, wife of Emperor Ashravan, killed by Glory Faction assassins.

items.text: Glory Faction assassins killed her in the attack that left Ashravan brain-dead. Her death let the arbiters hide his state, claiming he had withdrawn for the traditional hundred days of mourning while Shai worked to Forge him a new mind.
Researching Ashravan's life, Shai found that his first love, a girl from a storybook, had red hair, which she thought drew him to Kurshina. She also learned he had once come close to an affair.
Woken by Shai's stamp, Ashravan remembered her death and showed a flash of deep grief before hiding it, and he vowed to punish her killers.

appearance.text: She has red hair, and is probably close in age to her husband, who is forty.
